Welcome to Royal Roofing, your trusted source for all your roofing needs. We are a locally owned and operated company with 15 years of experience in the roofing industry. Choose Royal Roofing for all your roofing needs and experience the peace of mind that comes with working with a trusted and reliable company. **When you call us about your roof, we are the roofers. We do not subcontract out.**

When you want an honest, experienced roofing company to help protect your home or business with reliable, quality roofing installations and repairs, depend on the professional roofers from Royal Roofing.

# Metal Roofing

Standing seam metal roofing has metal panels that interlock at the edges to form a seal. It’s divided into two different categories, architectural and structural. Architectural standing seam roofing is the best type of metal roof for steep-sloped roofing. Depending on the design, the panels are either mechanically seamed or snapped together. And, unlike r-panel roofing, architectural roofing requires materials to be laid down beforehand.

## WARRANTY

We stand behind our work, which is why we provide homeowners with a **lifetime manufacturer warranty** and a **10-year workmanship warranty** on every roof we install. We are dedicated to making sure that our customers are 100% satisfied. No other roofing contractor gives you more confidence.

## INSURANCE CLAIM

If a storm damages your home, you need the help of an experienced team of home restoration specialists to ensure your property is fully restored to pre-storm condition. Our team works directly with your insurance company to ensure just that. We are there every step of the way, from the initial inspection to making sure all damages are covered.



## Military, First Responders, & Senior Discounts

To show our support for our military and community we offer a 5% Discount on any full roof and gutter installation or repair over $1,500 for our Military, First Responders, and Senior Citizens.
